build_spec_manager: build a SpecManager from a dict mapping UIDs to dm_env_rpc TensorSpecs
unpack_tensors: unpack a UID-keyed dm_env_rpc tensor map to a name-keyed Python dict with scalars and arrays
pack_tensors: pack a name-keyed Python dict of scalars and arrays into a UID-keyed dm_env_rpc tensor map
lookup_name_to_uid: look up the integer UID for a given tensor spec name string
lookup_uid_to_spec: look up the TensorSpec proto for a given integer UID
